articles.title: Web3 gaming network Sandbox stops Base and BNB chain bridging after exploit
articles.snippet: The Sandbox disabled bridging on affected networks to isolate tokens and warned users not to trade SAND on Base and BNB, citing an impact of under 0.01% of supply.

articles.title: MANTRA token plunges 18% to record low as blockchain halts after exploit
articles.snippet: The token touched $0.004126 minutes before the network stopped producing blocks, while MANTRA later said an attacker exploited a vulnerability in software used by the chain.

articles.title: CFTC chair says agency will move forward on crypto regulation if CLARITY fails
articles.snippet: Michael Selig said at a meeting of the Innovation Advisory Committee that he had directed CFTC staff to explore developer protections and other crypto-related policies.

articles.title: Microsoft Fixes 'Perfect 10' Exploit That Could Have Let Hackers Run Code Remotely
articles.snippet: The Entra ID flaw earned the highest possible severity score, but Microsoft says it patched the bug before publishing the CVE and found no evidence it was ever exploited.

articles.title: Coldcard Adds New Security Measures After $130 Million Bitcoin Exploit
articles.snippet: Coinkite's latest firmware requires users to add their own randomness when generating wallet seeds and fixes additional security issues uncovered during a three-week review.
